defectsAuditedAndRemediated.auditFinding: 48CS2 repurposed notification_candidates as canonical per-user delivery queue.
defectsAuditedAndRemediated.remediation: De-coupled into 4 distinct entities: NotificationCandidate (source/discovery staging), CareerSignalEvent (canonical official event), CareerSignalView (user-specific interpretation), and NotificationEvent (user delivery alert transport).

defectsAuditedAndRemediated.auditFinding: 48CS2 reducer mixed UPCOMING/ACTIVE states with canonical 12-state vocabulary.
defectsAuditedAndRemediated.remediation: Standardized on ONE canonical 12-state recruitment cycle vocabulary (ANNOUNCED, APPLICATION_OPEN, APPLICATION_CLOSED, EXAM_SCHEDULED, EXAM_COMPLETED, ANSWER_KEY_STAGE, RESULT_STAGE, INTERVIEW_OR_DV_STAGE, FINAL_RESULT_DECLARED, CYCLE_CLOSED, CANCELLED, STATUS_UNRESOLVED). UPCOMING and ACTIVE are derived helpers only.

defectsAuditedAndRemediated.auditFinding: Prior design relied on arbitrary now + 7 days signal expiry.
defectsAuditedAndRemediated.remediation: Signal active state is derived strictly from application deadline, official amendments, cycle stage, and process stage. Zero arbitrary expiry offsets.

defectsAuditedAndRemediated.auditFinding: When evaluation.eligible was false, system blindly collapsed state into Incomplete / More Information Needed.
defectsAuditedAndRemediated.remediation: Differentiated: known failed rule -> strictly NOT_ELIGIBLE; missing profile field -> MORE_INFORMATION_NEEDED; missing official rule -> NOT_EVALUATED.

defectsAuditedAndRemediated.auditFinding: academicMatch and qualificationMatch were both set to evaluation.eligible.
defectsAuditedAndRemediated.remediation: Separated dimensions: academicMatch evaluates stream/discipline, qualificationMatch evaluates degree level, locationMatch evaluates domicile constraints.

defectsAuditedAndRemediated.auditFinding: title.contains("mbbs") was used to derive career family.
defectsAuditedAndRemediated.remediation: Binds canonical careerFamily from official source taxonomy. String heuristics demoted to SUGGESTED_ONLY.

defectsAuditedAndRemediated.auditFinding: Assumed all opportunities were job vacancies.
defectsAuditedAndRemediated.remediation: Introduced explicit opportunityKind: JOB_RECRUITMENT, ADMISSION_ENTRANCE, OTHER_OFFICIAL_OPPORTUNITY. JEE/NEET typed as ADMISSION_ENTRANCE.
